name: InsertPolysIntersection
formula: =LAMBDA(verticesA,verticesB,LET(n, ROWS(verticesB), intersections, SEQUENCE(n, 1, 1, 1), results, REDUCE(verticesA, SEQUENCE(n), LAMBDA(a,i, LET(xi, INDEX(verticesB, i, 1), yi, INDEX(verticesB, i, 2), xj, INDEX(verticesB, IF(i = n, 1, i + 1), 1), yj, INDEX(verticesB, IF(i = n, 1, i + 1), 2), {ref}InsertPolyAndLineIntersection(a, xi, yi, xj, yj)))), results))
comment: A helper function. Add all intersection points of 2 polygons to the polygon A. Return the vertices A with intersection points. Last Update at 2024-06-23.
